isitan-4r-hms.name: 4R HMS hydraulic 4-roll plate rollers
isitan-4r-hms.summary: ISITAN's main line of 4-roll plate rolling machines, from a 2.1 ft bench-size roll to 10.2 ft machines that roll 3/8″ plate. The pinch roll and both side rolls move on a pyramid-style linear path driven by hydraulic cylinders, while the top roll is powered by an electric motor through a planetary gearbox — so the sheet is pinched, pre-bent at both ends and rolled into a full cylinder without being removed from the machine. Cone bending, hydraulic drop-end and three digital readouts are standard; NC control with programmed roll positions, overhead crane and side supports turn it into a semi- or fully automatic production line.
features: Pinch and side rolls moved linearly by hydraulic cylinders; top roll driven by motor and planetary gearbox, bottom roll through a cardan joint
Three digital readouts for easy roll positioning; mobile control panel
Hydraulic drop-end for easy removal of finished cylinders; hydraulic balancing system
Induction-hardened forged or rolled SAE 1050 (CK45) steel rolls; welded steel frames
Cone-bending device and overload protection standard
Remote technical support via Wi-Fi; built to EC safety directives (CE marked)
optional: NC control with remote assistance — teach mode, stored programs, 4 axes expandable to 7
Overhead crane and hydraulic side supports for large diameters
Vacuum sheet feeder and part ejector for full automation
Ground and polished rolls; two-speed or infinitely variable speed; hydraulic motor for rotation
Custom voltage: 208 V, 240 V, 480 V or 600 V 3-phase, or 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor

sahinler-4r-hss.summary: The heavy-duty 4-roll plate bending machines for wind-tower, shipyard, pressure-vessel and pipeline work: 42 models from 6.7 ft to 20 ft that roll plate up to 3-3/8″ thick. The pinch roll and both side rolls travel on a pyramid linear path on hydraulic cylinders, so the cylinders put all their force into the plate; the top roll is driven by motor and planetary gearbox with two speeds. Three digital readouts, hydraulic roll balancing, a cone-bending device and a hydraulic tilting drop-end are standard; NC or CNC control (ESA, Italy), overhead crane, side supports and a plate ejector turn the machine into a wheel-rim or shell production line.

sahinler-3r-uhs.name: 3R UHS 3-roll hydraulic translating heavy-duty plate rolls
sahinler-3r-uhs.summary: Three-roll plate rolls of the translating type: the two bottom rolls move horizontally, which gives a low working height, a smaller foundation pit (none on the smaller models), the best pre-bending on every diameter and more plate thickness than equivalent 3- or 4-roll machines — up to 3-1/2″ on the 3R UHS 30-680. Reducing the side-roll distance improves pre-bending on small diameters, heavy cones are rolled in several strokes and the solid frame also works as a press for re-rolling and calibrating tubes. Hydraulic drop-end, brake system, cone-bending device and electronic roll balancing are standard.
features: Horizontally moving bottom rolls — lower working height, smaller or no foundation pit, reduced overall dimensions
Best pre-bending on every required diameter; large working stroke; no need to tilt the top roll to remove finished tubes
Bends thicker plate than equivalent 3- or 4-roll machines; heavy cones produced in several strokes
Solid construction lets the machine work as a press brake for re-rolling and calibrating tubes
Two-speed operation; cone-bending device; electronic roll balancing; standard brake system; hydraulic drop-end
SAE 1050 (CK45-50) forged or hot-rolled, induction-hardened and polished rolls
optional: NC control system
Overhead crane and hydraulic side supports for large diameters
Custom voltage: 208 V, 240 V, 480 V or 600 V 3-phase, or 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor

sahinler-3r-hs.name: 3R HS 3-roll hydraulic plate rolls
sahinler-3r-hs.summary: Double-pinch 3-roll plate bending machines for light and medium plate, aluminum and stainless steel: the side rolls move on an orbital path with hydraulic cylinders, all three rolls are driven by a single planetary gearbox and gear system and hydraulic balancing keeps them parallel. Cone-bending device with ball bearing, hydraulic drop-end and extended roll shafts for profile and pipe bending rolls are standard — one machine rolls cylinders, cones and, with the optional roll set, angle and pipe.
features: Side rolls move on an orbital path with hydraulic cylinders; hydraulic balancing for parallel roll movement
All 3 rolls driven by a single planetary gearbox and gear system
Cone-bending device with ball bearing; hydraulic drop-end
Extended shafts for profile and pipe bending rolls
Mobile control panel; overload protection
SAE 1050 (CK45-50) forged or hot-rolled, induction-hardened and polished rolls; welded steel frames; CE marked
optional: Profile bending roll set on the extended shafts
Overhead crane and hydraulic side supports for large diameters
Ground rolls; infinitely variable speed; electronic roll balancing
